Breadboard model and textures are imported from Grab3D's “Breadboard” CC0 1.0 package.
Model page: https://grab3d.com/models/electronics/breadboard/
Downloaded 2026-11-05. The source package includes its CC0 license in Breadboard_OBJ/LICENSE.txt.

Unity uses the bundled OBJ, MTL and JPEG textures under Breadboard_OBJ/. The source model is 165.1 x 54.45 x 20.6 mm before axis conversion. Visible holes, rails, and a few example components are part of the licensed model. BenchFlow keeps snapping coordinates and electrical connectivity in BreadboardGrid.cs.
